senses.definition_en: storm cloud

examples.english:
Eternal sun,
such storm clouds
bestow life upon my love, Mileno,
to command everyone.
examples.ref: c. 1600, Lope de Vega, Las batuecas del duque de Alba, Spain, lines 284-286:
examples.text:
Sol eterno,
que por nubarrones tales
da vida al mi amor, Mileno,
para que los mande a todos.
examples.translation:
Eternal sun,
such storm clouds
bestow life upon my love, Mileno,
to command everyone.

examples.english: Other masters, who follow a false doctrine, sent by the evil spirit, who are heretics, and malicious Christians, who are like heavy storm clouds, pelting hail, stone, and lightning, with which souls are sterilized.
examples.ref: 1617, Nicolás de Arnaya, Conferencias espiritvales, vtiles y prouechosas para todo genero y eſtado de personas, volume II, Sevilla: Franciſco de Lyra, page 60:
examples.text: Otros maeſtros, que lo ſon de falſa dotrina, embiados por el eſpiritu de la maldad, que ſon los Hereges, y peruerſos Chriſtianos, los quales ſon como nubarrones eſpeſos, que arrojan granizo, piedra, y rayos, con lo qual ſe eſterilizan las almas.
examples.translation: Other masters, who follow a false doctrine, sent by the evil spirit, who are heretics, and malicious Christians, who are like heavy storm clouds, pelting hail, stone, and lightning, with which souls are sterilized.

glosses: storm cloud
